description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Wind 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dragon's Tornado] and [Dragon's Tornado Damage Cap] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Dragon's Tornado
description.text: Grants [Dragon's Tornado 10% Boost]/[Dragon's Tornado 20% Boost]/[Dragon's Tornado 30% Boost]/[Dragon's Tornado 40% Boost]/[Dragon's Tornado 50% Boost] to the user after a ally uses 1/2/3/4/5+ Dragoon abilities

description.name: Dragon's Tornado Damage Cap
description.text: Grants [Damage Cap +10000 1] to the user after another ally uses a Dragoon ability
